module counter_12 
(
  input rst_n,
  input clk,
  input valid_count,

  output reg [3:0] out
);

  reg [3:0] out_reg;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (~rst_n) begin
      out_reg <= 4'b0000;
    end else begin
      if (valid_count && (out_reg != 4'd11)) begin
        out_reg <= out_reg + 1;
      end
    end
  end

  always @* begin
    out = out_reg;
  end

endmodule

module multi_pipe_4bit#(
	parameter size = 4
)(
	input 						clk 		,   
	input 						rst_n		,
	input	[size-1:0]			mul_a		,
	input	[size-1:0]			mul_b		,
 
 	output	reg	[size*2-1:0]	mul_out		
);

parameter N = 2 * size;

reg [N-1:0] partial_products [0:size-1];

always @ (posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
	if (~rst_n) begin
		for (int i = 0; i < size; i = i + 1) begin
			partial_products[i] <= 0;
		end
	end else begin
		for (int i = 0; i < size; i = i + 1) begin
			if (i == 0) begin
				if (mul_b[i] == 1) begin
					partial_products[i] <= {mul_a, 4'b0};
				end
			end else begin
				if (mul_b[i] == 1) begin
					partial_products[i] <= {partial_products[i-1][N-2:i], 4'b0};
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

always @ (posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
	if (~rst_n) begin
		mul_out <= 0;
	end else begin
		mul_out <= partial_products[size-1];
	end
end

endmodule

module pulse_detect(    
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input data_in,
    output reg data_out
);

reg [1:0] state;
reg data_in_prev;

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (~rst_n) begin
        state <= 2'b00; // Idle state
        data_out <= 1'b0;
        data_in_prev <= 1'b0;
    end
    else begin
        data_in_prev <= data_in;
        case(state)
            2'b00: begin // Idle state
                if (data_in_prev == 1'b0 && data_in == 1'b1) begin
                    state <= 2'b01; // First transition
                end
            end
            2'b01: begin // First transition
                if (data_in_prev == 1'b1 && data_in == 1'b0) begin
                    state <= 2'b10; // Second transition
                end
                else if (data_in_prev == 1'b0 && data_in == 1'b1) begin
                    state <= 2'b01; // Stay in first transition
                end
                else begin
                    state <= 2'b00; // Reset to idle state
                end
            end
            2'b10: begin // Second transition
                if (data_in_prev == 1'b0 && data_in == 1'b1) begin
                    state <= 2'b11; // Pulse detected
                    data_out <= 1'b1;
                end
                else if (data_in_prev == 1'b1 && data_in == 1'b0) begin
                    state <= 2'b10; // Stay in second transition
                end
                else begin
                    state <= 2'b00; // Reset to idle state
                end
            end
            2'b11: begin // Pulse detected
                state <= 2'b00; // Reset to idle state
                data_out <= 1'b0;
            end
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule

module signal_generator(
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  output reg [4:0] wave
);

  reg [0:0] state;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (~rst_n) begin
      state <= 1'b0;
      wave <= 5'b0;
    end
    else begin
      case (state)
        1'b0: begin
          if (wave == 5'b11111) begin
            state <= 1'b1;
          end
          else begin
            wave <= wave + 1;
          end
        end
        1'b1: begin
          if (wave == 5'b00000) begin
            state <= 1'b0;
          end
          else begin
            wave <= wave - 1;
          end
        end
      endcase
    end
  end

endmodule
